sources.title: Official menu named-allergen identity audit

No Nutella brand ingredient disclosure was located; no claim made for Nutella.

proposedChanges: Remove 43 baseline parser-derived allergen claims not supported by direct official named identity or matrix evidence.
Add six direct named-identity positives: tree-nut for two explicitly almond-named products and milk for four explicitly cheese-named products.
Keep Nutella, Café au Lait, macaron, quiches, omelets, croissants, breads, pastries, crepes, waffles, brioche, and sourdough unset unless an explicit allergen identity is present.
Keep SinglePlatform noncurrent supporting-only; official menu is the sole complete 45-key publishing surface.
